name: May’s Grill
kurzbeschreibung:
**May’s Grill in Innsbruck**

Discover authentic Tyrolean flavors at **May’s Grill** in the heart of **Innsbruck**. This cozy, family-run restaurant has been serving up hearty dishes since 1952, blending traditional Alpine cuisine with a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Start your meal with a crisp **Schlutzkrapfen**—crispy fried dumplings stuffed with spinach and ricotta—or dig into a **Kaiserschmarrn**, the fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into pieces and served with powdered sugar and apricot jam. For meat lovers, the **Tiroler Gröstl** (a rustic potato and bacon hash) or a juicy **Wildschweinbraten** (wild boar roast) are must-tries.

Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** from the local brewery or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** from the nearby **Lech** region. The rustic wooden interiors and hand-painted murals of **Tirol’s** alpine landscapes make every visit feel like stepping into a storybook.

Whether you’re craving a quick lunch or a leisurely dinner, **May’s Grill** offers a taste of **Tirol’s** culinary heritage in every bite. Don’t forget to save room for dessert—**Apfelstrudel** with vanilla sauce is a perfect way to end your meal.

**Location:** Right in the center of **Innsbruck**, just a short walk from the **Goldenes Dachl** and **Nordkette** cable car station.

**Opening Hours:**
- **Monday–Friday:** 11:30 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Saturday–Sunday:** 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Come experience the charm of **Tirol’s** best-kept secret—**May’s Grill** awaits!
